scope.title: Scope name
scope.description: Name of the global scope for this application. Define an organizational tenant.

cluster.title: Cluster name
cluster.description: Name of the cluster running this application. Define a platform tenant.

environment.title: Environment name
environment.description: Name of the environment for this application. Define a stage tenant.

component.title: Component name
component.description: Name of the component consisting of this application. Define a logical tenant.

app.title: Application name
app.description: Name of the application name. Define a functional tenant.

version.title: Version name
version.description: Name of the application version. Define this chaos version. Should be incremented each time application configuration is changed to keep track of changes and allow ease rollin of the application (and rollout in case of problem). Default use Chart appVersion.

expose.title: Expose signal
expose.description: Enable exposition for this application (route based)

sleep_time.title: Sleep time
sleep_time.description: Sleep time beetween 2 checks of the targeted cluster

watch_nodes.title: Watch nodes
watch_nodes.description: Enable watching nodes health as part of the global health signal

watch_cluster_operators.title: Watch cluster operators
watch_cluster_operators.description: Enable watching cluster operator health as part of the global health signal

isDaemon.title: Cerberus is daemon
isDaemon.description: Run cerberus as a daemon (infinite loop instead of a fixed number of iterations)

mode.title: Kubeconfig mode
mode.description: Connection mode to use for the cluster (could be token, file, or local)

file.title: Kubeconfig file
file.description: If mode is file, this property must be set with a full kubeconfig content
examples:
kind: Config
apiVersion: v1
current-context: default

server.title: API endpoint
server.description: The server URL to the target cluster API

token.title: API token
token.description: The token to use to get access. A read-only access (cluster-reader) is enough

ca.title: API certificate authority
ca.description: PEM content of the certificate authority of the target cluster API

insecure.title: Skip TLS verification
insecure.description: Skip the TLS verification of the target cluster API (only used when no ca is given)

watch_url_routes.title: Watch routes
watch_url_routes.description: Url list of endpoint to watch as part of the global healthcheck (double array)

watch_terminating_namespaces.title: Watch terminating namespaces
watch_terminating_namespaces.description: Enable watching terminating namespaces as part of the global health signal

watch_namespaces.title: Watch namespaces
watch_namespaces.description: List of namespaces to watch (supports regex patterns)

watch_namespaces_ignore_pattern.title: Namespace ignore patterns
watch_namespaces_ignore_pattern.description: Regex patterns for namespaces to exclude from watching

custom_checks.title: Custom checks
custom_checks.description: List of custom check scripts (paths relative to /root/cerberus/ working directory)

image.title: Cerberus image
image.description: Cerberus container image (pin it by digest, upstream publishes no versioned tag)

tag.title: Image tag
tag.description: Image tag, used when no digest is set

digest.title: Image digest
digest.description: Image digest, takes precedence over the tag

privileged.title: Privileged
privileged.description: Run the cerberus container as privileged (binds the service account to the privileged SCC)

resources.title: Resources
resources.description: Resources requests and limits of the cerberus container

allowedNamespaces.title: Allowed namespaces
allowedNamespaces.description: Namespaces allowed to query the cerberus health signal (networkpolicy)

iterations.title: Iterations
iterations.description: Number of iterations when cerberus is not a daemon

timeout.title: Timeout
timeout.description: Timeout of a single check (in seconds)

watch_master_schedulable.title: Watch schedulable control plane
watch_master_schedulable.description: Enable watching for schedulable control plane nodes as part of the global health signal

controlPlaneLabel.title: Control plane label
controlPlaneLabel.description: Label identifying the control plane nodes

customCheckScripts.title: Custom check scripts
customCheckScripts.description: Custom check scripts added to the cerberus configuration (file name: python content)
